_what: Reading of every continuation in probe-sampled.jsonl (temperature 0.7, 3 samples per stem), 22 Sep 2026, done blind per item against the expected outcome in tools/probe_knowledge.json. Same verdict vocabulary as probe-readings.json.

d34-22btok/probe_planck_constant/0.note: Arithmetic nonsense about prime numbers and x2+y2=4; nothing about energy, frequency, or a constant.

d34-22btok/probe_planck_constant/2.note: Garbled arithmetic about 'the first power of 5 is 7'; no physics.
